item.title: Patch: Broadcom VMware ESX: Insufficient Logging
item.description:
Broadcom VMware ESX: exploited · fix: 5.2.4, ESXi-9.1.0.0-25370933, ESXi-9.0.2.0100-25595025

First step: Update Broadcom VMware ESX to the fixed version for your release line (for example 5.2.4, ESXi-9.1.0.0-25370933 or ESXi-9.0.2.0100-25595025).

Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

Low · Fix available · CVE-2026-41709
